title: Weekend Plans
topic: making, changing, and negotiating weekend plans with a friend
scene: Two coworkers are chatting on Thursday afternoon, trying to turn a vague 'we should hang out' into a real plan.
goals: 在电影、展览、吃饭之间做选择
因为天气改计划，还不让对话冷掉
协调三个人的时间和口味

lecture.overview: 约周末看起来简单，真正难的是把「有空吗」变成可执行计划。先练 Are you free on Saturday? 再练 I could do ... / I'm leaning toward ... 这种带倾向的表达。B1 以后重点是改计划：If it rains, we can ... 以及照顾别人约束时的协商。口语里少用 must，多用 could、maybe、unless。

patterns.en: I could do brunch, or we could catch a movie.
patterns.zh: 早午餐也行，看电影也行。
patterns.note: could 表示弹性，不是命令
表达偏好，但不把对方逼死

patterns.en: If it rains, we can switch to ...
patterns.zh: 要是下雨，我们可以改成……

tips: 先确认有没有空，再抛选项，对方比较好接。
给两个选项比给一个更像商量，不像摊派。
改时间时先道歉一句，再立刻补新方案。

dialogues.title: 周六有空吗
dialogues.summary: 最基础的邀请：有空、喝咖啡、定时间。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey. Are you free on Saturday?
turns.zh: 嘿，你周六有空吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I think so. What's up?
turns.zh: 应该有。怎么了？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Want to get coffee in the afternoon?
turns.zh: 下午要不要喝咖啡？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, that sounds good.
turns.zh: 好啊，听起来不错。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Around three?
turns.zh: 三点左右？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Three works for me.
turns.zh: 三点可以。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: There's a quiet cafe near the park.
turns.zh: 公园附近有家安静的咖啡馆。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Perfect. Text me the name.
turns.zh: 完美。把店名发给我。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure. See you Saturday.
turns.zh: 好。周六见。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: See you. I'm looking forward to it.
turns.zh: 回见。我很期待。

dialogues.title: 电影还是展览
dialogues.summary: 两个选项里做选择，并说出理由。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: So, movie or museum this weekend?
turns.zh: 那这周末看电影还是看展？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Hmm. I could do either.
turns.zh: 嗯，两个都行。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I'm leaning toward the museum. It's quieter.
turns.zh: 我更想去博物馆，比较安静。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That's fair. Which one?
turns.zh: 有道理。哪一家？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: The photography one downtown. It closes at six.
turns.zh: 市中心那个摄影展，六点关门。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Then we should go after lunch.
turns.zh: 那我们应该午饭后去。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Want to grab noodles first?
turns.zh: 要不要先吃碗面？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes. I'm always up for noodles.
turns.zh: 好。我永远可以吃面。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Great. I'll book tickets, just in case.
turns.zh: 太好了。我先订票，以防万一。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Smart. Send me the time.
turns.zh: 聪明。把时间发给我。

dialogues.title: 下雨改计划
dialogues.summary: 天气预报不好，练习改方案但不取消见面。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Have you seen the forecast? Saturday looks awful.
turns.zh: 你看天气预报了吗？周六很糟。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, rain all afternoon. Outdoor plans are out.
turns.zh: 对，一下午都下雨。户外就算了。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: If it rains, we can switch to a movie.
turns.zh: 要是下雨，我们可以改看电影。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm fine with that. Anything except a horror film.
turns.zh: 我没问题。除了恐怖片什么都行。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: There's a new comedy at 2:40.
turns.zh: 两点四十有部新喜剧。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That works, unless you still want the museum.
turns.zh: 可以，除非你还想去博物馆。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: The museum can wait. I'd rather not get soaked.
turns.zh: 博物馆可以以后再去。我可不想淋成落汤鸡。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Same here. Let's meet in the lobby at 2:20.
turns.zh: 我也是。两点二十大厅见。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Deal. I'll grab the tickets tonight.
turns.zh: 成交。今晚我去买票。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks. Text me if the time changes.
turns.zh: 谢了。时间有变就发消息。

dialogues.title: 三个人怎么约
dialogues.summary: 再加一个朋友，时间、饮食、预算都要协商。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Chris wants to join, but he's free only after five.
turns.zh: Chris 也想加入，可他五点后才有空。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Then the afternoon movie is tight. Dinner might be easier.
turns.zh: 那下午电影就紧了。晚饭可能更容易。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: He's vegetarian, so somewhere with real options.
turns.zh: 他吃素，得找一家真有素食可选的。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: There's a Thai place that's reasonable, not fancy.
turns.zh: 有家泰国菜不贵，也不摆谱。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Good. I'm trying not to blow the budget this month.
turns.zh: 好。这个月我不想把预算花超。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Same. We could split a few dishes and keep it light.
turns.zh: 我也是。可以拼几道菜，吃轻松点。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I'll check with Chris and lock in 6:30, unless he pushes back.
turns.zh: 我去问 Chris，先定 6:30，除非他反对。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: If 6:30 is too early, 7 is still fine on my side.
turns.zh: 如果 6:30 太早，我这边 7 点也行。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Appreciate it. I'll send a group chat once it's settled.
turns.zh: 谢了。定下来我就拉群。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Perfect. Weekend rescued.
turns.zh: 完美。周末保住了。

vocab.note: 邀约第一句，后面再跟具体活动
to 后面接名词或 doing

vocab.example: I'll book tickets, just in case.
vocab.note: 口语里极常用的保险说法
改户外计划时的开口词

vocab.example: If it rains, we can switch to a movie.
I'm trying not to blow the budget this month.
I'll lock in 6:30, unless he pushes back.
I'll send a group chat once it's settled.
